package sample

import (
    "context"
    "io"
    "net/http"
    "time"

    rpcx "example.com/rpcx/v2"
)

type outboundResponse struct { Response *http.Response }

// invoke 是原型自建的同步边界，不是业务参考答案。
func invoke(request *http.Request, exchange func(context.Context) (*http.Response, error)) (*http.Response, error) {
    unregister := rpcx.Register("ownership-study", func(ctx context.Context, _ string, _, out any) error {
        response, err := exchange(ctx)
        out.(*outboundResponse).Response = response
        return err
    })
    defer unregister()
    client, err := rpcx.Dial("ownership-study")
    if err != nil { return nil, err }
    var response outboundResponse
    callCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(request.Context(), 30*time.Second)
    err = client.Call(callCtx, "http.do", request, &response)
    if err != nil {
        cancel()
        return response.Response, err
    }
    if response.Response == nil || response.Response.Body == nil {
        cancel()
        return response.Response, nil
    }
    response.Response.Body = &releaseBody{ReadCloser: response.Response.Body, release: cancel}
    return response.Response, nil
}

type releaseBody struct {
    io.ReadCloser
    release context.CancelFunc
}

func (body *releaseBody) Close() error {
    defer body.release()
    return body.ReadCloser.Close()
}
